description: Cube-map skyboxes (px,nx,py,ny,pz,nz; 1024x1024 JPEG, three.js CubeTextureLoader order) built from equirectangular panoramas published by Poly Haven. Faces are oriented so a CubeTexture scene.background renders identically to the source equirect with EquirectangularReflectionMapping.

jurassic.name: Mossy Forest
jurassic.edits: rotated 90 degrees about the vertical axis so the mossy stream faces +z and the stone-slab footpath is out of the default view

cretaceous.name: Plains Sunset
cretaceous.edits: retouched out small radio masts on the distant mesa

marine.name: Aristea Wreck (Pure Sky)
marine.edits: real coastal sky; everything below the horizon replaced by a procedurally synthesized open sea that reflects this sky (no clean Poly Haven ocean panorama without buildings/roads/wrecks was available)

iceage.name: Horn-koppe Snow
iceage.edits: retouched out a small hut roof and a thin overhead wire at the forest edge
